**Gateway 503 outage — on-call handoff**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14Z) — "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation." Right after it landed, the pool started throwing `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` (size 20, in_use 20, connections never returned), and the backlog of waiting requests climbed steadily with no recovery.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14 02:14:18Z to at least 03:59:27Z, the end of the current log — still ongoing when the log cuts off. Scope is gateway only: `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders` all hit 503s; `/health` mostly still returned 200. Worker jobs stayed healthy the whole time.

**Rollback:** revert `dep-4471` on the gateway. No other service or deploy is implicated.
